scenes.say: [knowing, slightly amused] Your deck... is upside down.
[casual] Most decks tell it like a story. Background... analysis... options... and the answer, last. [beat] [emphatic] Partners flip it. The answer goes first.

titles: We can fund it from margins
scenes.say: [conversational] Then every slide after it is proof. [confident] Why it's right... why now... and how we pay for it.
[upbeat] Answer first. Then the proof. Background last, if at all. [playful] Now go flip your deck.
